title: [SOLVED] Can't orphan a package
body: Hi, I'm trying to orphan a library package as the developers are looking for a package maintainer since the current one has proven to be unreachable. So I decided to take the package upon myself and submitted an orphan request, on April 29th. From what I understand, according to the AUR wiki, if an orphan request goes unanswered for 14 days, it's automatically granted, but it's still hanging. Is there something specific I'm meant to do? Last edited by Henonicks (2026-05-15 12:04:28)
